    • Layout capsules

    page-header, gradient-background and footer, in the configurations that differ.

    page-header wrapper

    This page uses <drop capsule="page-header" data-nav-page="layout">. It emits a real <header> landmark and centres the pill.

    Scroll up: the nav you see is inside that header element.

    gradient-background, animated

    Dropped with data-animated="true". The blobs drift. Enable Reduce Motion in System Settings and reload: the drift stops but the blur stays.

    The gradient is fixed behind all content at z-index below the page.

    footer capsule, slot content

    The footer at the bottom of every lab page is <drop capsule="footer"> with a paragraph in its slot.

    Its muting comes from --text-muted, not a blanket opacity.

    Nested capsule in a card

    A card-list item containing a button-array drop, to show capsules nesting inside arbitrary markup.

    The nav below sits inside a card-list item.
